context7.description: Live docs for React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Radix, TipTap, Firebase, Express, OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services Speech, TanStack Query, Zod

firebase.description: Firestore + Auth + Storage MCP. Set SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH to your wedding-ease-dc99a-firebase-adminsdk-*.json file path. Use read-only operations by default; ask before any write.

playwright.description: Browser automation for Wedding-Ease-Viva-Chat manual QA + qa-screenshots.mjs replacement. Use for visual regression, flow capture, and codegen.

chrome-devtools.description: Official Chrome DevTools MCP (ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp). Full DevTools: network panel, console, performance traces, Lighthouse, screenshots. Pair with Playwright MCP — Playwright drives, DevTools observes.

posthog.description: Official PostHog MCP (HTTP transport, replaces deprecated @posthog/agent-toolkit npm package). Auth via personal API key (phx_*) from POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY env var (set in ~/.claude/settings.json env block).
